slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: groups
slots.about: id, label; one section each, in this order; a group with no items is hidden

slots.name: items
slots.about: saved: id, group, name, note (may be empty), done

slots.name: left_word
slots.about: after a count of what is not done, with a leading space

slots.name: all_done_line
slots.about: a section header when everything in it is done

slots.name: done_word
slots.about: spoken after a done row's name

slots.name: not_done_word
slots.about: spoken after an open row's name

slots.name: clear_label
slots.about: the button that removes the done rows

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: shown when there are no items at all

open.shows: one section per group with items, open rows first, done rows below them, a count left per section and in total

section_done.shows: a section with nothing left says all_done_line

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise and smooth
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a done row changes its mark from an empty circle to a checked one and says done in words
